case: built-in inet[] and cidr[] binary result, inferred bind, keyed edit, CSV restore and invalid-input refusal
contract: Binary inet[] and cidr[] results preserve IPv4/IPv6 addresses, prefixes, SQL NULL and non-default lower bounds using element OIDs 869 and 650.
Inferred bindings and keyed edits preserve native array_send bytes; typed CSV import restores both array types.
Native type, text, JSON and wire comparisons cover host and network prefixes, including /0 and full address width.
Malformed prefixes and CIDR host bits are refused without changing target or sibling rows.
The built-in OID census includes inet and cidr; other unlisted built-in and custom array families remain open.
